title: Bar Drop Gummy Bear 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Gummy Bear by Drop is a playful tribute to the classic bag of mixed fruit sweets. It offers a medley of fruity notes—strawberry, lime, orange, and raspberry—blended into a distinctively sugary, gelatinous profile. The result is a vibrant, confectionery-inspired vape that bursts with nostalgia and sweetness. This e-liquid uses a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio to enhance the sugary top notes, ensuring the fruit medley tastes sharp and distinct rather than muddied. Ideally suited for low-wattage MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices, the nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
